Open neurons in Spelunker

octo_scene.Rd

Builds a Spelunker (Neuroglancer) link showing the given neurons on the octo EM, optionally coloured by a column of the seed table and with the seed points as annotations. The link is shortened through the CAVE state service; if that fails, a long link containing the whole state is returned.

Usage

octo_scene(
  ids = character(),
  color_by = NULL,
  colors = NULL,
  seeds = FALSE,
  position = NULL,
  layout = "xy-3d",
  shorten = TRUE,
  open = FALSE,
  table = getOption("octor.seatable_table")
)

Arguments

ids

root IDs (character); may be empty for a blank scene

color_by

seed table column to colour neurons by, e.g. "cell_type"

colors

colours instead of color_by: one colour, or a vector named by root ID or by values of color_by

seeds

add the seed points of these neurons as an annotation layer

position

centre of the view in Spelunker voxels; default the first neuron's seed (if found in the seed table)

layout

Neuroglancer layout, e.g. "xy-3d", "3d", "4panel"

shorten

upload the state and return a short link

open

open the link in the browser

table

SeaTable table name

Value

the link (invisibly if open = TRUE)

Details

The image and segmentation sources, voxel size and Spelunker address come from the datastack's settings on the CAVE server. Set options(octor.spelunker_url = ...) to use another viewer.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
octo_scene(octo_find_ids("^MBON"), color_by = "cell_type", open = TRUE)
octo_scene(c("720575940...", "720575940..."), colors = c("red", "cyan"))
} # }
